sourceProvenance.title: Passarinho da Lagoa
sourceProvenance.composer: Tradicional do Rio Grande do Norte
sourceProvenance.edition: Traditional Rio Grande do Norte children's round documented by Dulce Caldas in 1947 and Verissimo de Melo in Rondas infantis brasileiras (1953); independent Pianify notation and harmony
sourceProvenance.license: Public Domain traditional children's round; copyrighted art-song settings are excluded
normalization: The first sounding note is normalized to 0 seconds.
Exact simultaneous duplicate pitches are reduced to one note.
Repeated pitches are separated by a 20 ms release gap when the source sustain overlaps the next attack.
No pitch is transposed and no source note is removed to fit the visual keyboard.

crossCheckReferences.role: documents the children's round collected by Dulce Caldas and published by Verissimo de Melo

crossCheckReferences.provider: Centro Nacional de Folclore e Cultura Popular
crossCheckReferences.role: official archival catalogue cross-check for the traditional folk performance

derivation.melody: independent notation of the traditional children's-round melody; no Waldemar Henrique or other copyrighted art-song setting is used
derivation.harmony: Pianify editorial piano harmonization v1, clearly separated from the source melody
